name: Time Is A Circle extends Singularity Core when Wand of Time is cast (#11228)
contract: Time Is A Circle 806206 applies aura 42 (proc trigger spell) on Wand Master 524962, whose three effect 177 (SPELL_EFFECT_ASCENSION_MODIFY_AURA_DURATION) slots name Paradox Cannon 806203, Flux Emitter 804435 and Aether Compression 804436, each by 3000 ms. Singularity Core 804438 is a fourth Continuum spell (its Spell.dbc description opens with Continuum Spell) that no slot names, so the tooltip's extension never reached it, as reported in #11228; a spell has only three effect slots, so a script bound to 524962 extends it by the same effect value. Singularity Core carries CasterAuraSpell 804455 (Echo Fragment), fixtured with set_aura; five stacks also give it the per-fragment duration bonus (Echo Fragment's effect 1 is SPELLMOD_DURATION, 5000 ms per stack) so its DurationIndex 28 base of 5000 ms becomes long enough to observe. The assertion is relative to a snapshot taken 1.5 s later: without the repair the remaining duration can only have fallen, so a positive delta discriminates and needs no randomness.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Echo Fragments satisfy Singularity Core's CasterAuraSpell

Let the Continuum duration decay measurably
Singularity Core duration before Wand of Time
Casting Wand of Time extends the Continuum spell
